# game/start_game.asm: Start of a game

Range `$827C-$829E`. Source: [game/start_game.asm](../../../../src/game/start_game.asm). Index: [the reference](../../index.md).

## Names

<a id="start_game"></a>
### [`start_game`](../../../../src/game/start_game.asm#L6) `$827C`

*label*

Start of a game from the setup screen. Copies the status texts, selects player 1 and joystick port 1, and sets music on. Clears the state of both players, then gives each player lender 1 ($4f01, $4f11) and the entry lawn $21 ($4f02, $4f12). Then starts the turn of player 1.

- **Jumped to from:** [`setup_screen`](../setup/setup_screen.md#setup_screen) [`$7DD8`](../../../../src/setup/setup_screen.asm#L112)
